title: Touhou Tenryuuguu ~ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds - Country of Flood
description:
The "Stage 1" theme from the game-without-a-game, Touhou-style music album, 東方天流宮 ～ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds.

It's a happy and optimistic song, fitting early-game levels. It gives me exploration vibes. And maybe it's a little wet-sounding too, by association with the title.

[05 May 2023] UPDATE: Fixed a missing y command and other minor mixing/ADSR tweaks.
